page.overview:
Who is Ben?

Ben is Marge's online friend in "Dangers on a Train".

After Marge accidentally registered on 'Sassy Madison', a site to help married people have affairs, the two began to talk to each other. Ben is neglected by his wife and must reside in the bathroom to watch his favourite series, 'Upton Rectory', a show which both him and Marge enjoy watching, and watch together at one point. When Homer and Ben's wife, Ramona find out about the two 'seeing' each other, they feel as though they are cheating on them. In the end, all of the misunderstandings are resolved as Marge goes off with Homer on the train, 'Li'l Lisa', that Homer and his friends were fixing for their anniversary surprise. Ramona and Ben seem to make up and leave happily.

Ben was voiced by Seth MacFarlane, the creator of Family Guy and American Dad!, another 20th Century Fox Television (1989-2020)/20th Television (2020-21)/20th Television Animation (2021-present) production.
